save.error: Not saved to your account — kept on this device
save.conflict: This project was changed on another device — your version is kept here; save again to replace it.
save.offline: no connection — it tries again by itself

media.hint: Drop files here or upload — videos, pictures, sounds, .cube LUTs and fonts. They wait here; drag what you want onto the timeline, or tap +.
media.empty: Your library is empty. Upload or drop files to start.
media.skipped: Not added (not a video, picture, sound, LUT or font): {{names}}
media.removeUsed: This file is on the timeline — remove it from there too?
media.nooiHint: Your finished videos, pictures and sounds from nooi.ai.
media.noJobs: Nothing finished yet — make something on nooi.ai and it shows here.
media.signIn: Sign in on nooi.ai to see what you made.

audio.noMic: The microphone isn't available — allow it in the browser.
audio.pickMusic: Pick the music clip first (or add music).
audio.cantRead: That sound can't be read here.
audio.beats: {{n}} beats on the ruler — clips snap to them.
audio.duckOn: Lower the music while someone speaks
audio.voiceTracks: Voice tracks (the others go quieter under them):
audio.none: No sounds yet — upload music or record a voice-over.

text.fontsHint: Arabic and Latin fonts with correct joining and right-to-left — pick one for a selected text in its panel.
text.fontsHint2: {{n}} fonts for Arabic, English, Spanish, French, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Hebrew and Thai — in each title's settings (Font), each shown in its own letters.

cap.hint: Write one caption per line (or bring an .srt / .vtt file). Each line becomes a caption from the playhead.
cap.auto: Automatic captions from speech (Arabic and English) come with the AI tools in Phase 2.
cap.trHint: {{n}} caption lines — translated by AI, each keeping its time.
cap.trNone: Add captions first (above), then translate them here.
cap.trFail: The translation couldn't be made — try again.

hint.effects: Point at an effect to see it on the preview; tap to add it to the selected clip.
hint.weather: Rain, snow, fog, light leaks, sparkles and old film — animated, on the selected clip.
hint.erase: Blur or pixelate one part of the picture (a face, a number plate, a logo). Place the box in the clip's Effects settings.
hint.motion: One tap moves the selected clip: zooms, pans, pops, shakes and fades. They are ordinary keyframes you can change.

tr.hint: Select the clip before a cut and tap a transition — or drag one onto the cut.

color.hint: Point at a look to see it; tap to use it on the selected clip. Fine-tune in the clip's Color tab.
color.more: Exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature and HSL are in the selected clip's Color tab.

col.lutHint: Import a .cube in the Color panel to use a LUT.

ai.hint: AI runs on nooi.ai's servers. You see the price first; credits are taken only when it works and given back if it fails.
ai.extendHint: The selected clip goes on from its last frame — same people, place and light. The new part lands right after it.
ai.extended: Extended — the new part is on the timeline.
ai.mergeHint: The selected clips become one video, joined so the join can't be seen. It goes to your library.
ai.merged: Merged — the video is in your library.
ai.pickTwo: Select two or more video clips (Shift-click).
ai.regenHint: Makes the selected nooi shot again from its words; it replaces the clip when ready.
ai.regenOnlyNooi: Only shots made on nooi.ai can be regenerated.
ai.failed: That didn't work — no credits were taken.
ai.needUpload: This file needs to reach your account first — sign in and try again.
ai.offline: The AI tools need the nooi.ai server.
ai.signIn: Sign in to use the AI tools with your credits.

soon.t2v: Text / image to video clips on the timeline
soon.prompt: Edit by asking ("remove the first 3 seconds…")

ai.join: Merge into one clip (the join can't be seen)
ai.extendedJoined: Extended — one clip on the timeline.
ai.joinFailed: Couldn't join them — the new part was added right after the clip.

preview.label: Preview
preview.empty: The timeline is empty — add media first.
preview.outside: Most of “{{name}}” is outside the picture.

insp.label: Properties
insp.many: {{n}} clips selected — changes apply to all.
insp.kfHint: ◆ beside a value sets a keyframe at the playhead; move the playhead and change the value to animate it.
insp.speedHint: 0.1× to 10×. The clips after it move to make room.
insp.denoiseHint: Noise reduction is applied in the export (RNNoise on this device).
insp.noEffects: No effects on this clip — add one from the Effects panel.
insp.pickHint: Select a clip on the timeline to see its properties.

tl.label: Timeline
tl.snap: Snap to edges, markers and beats
tl.locked: That track is locked — unlock it in its header.
tl.dropToLibrary: Drop files on the Media panel — they wait in your library.

toast.detached: The sound is on its own track now.
toast.noSound: This clip has no sound to detach.
toast.fontReady: Font {{name}} is ready in the font lists.
toast.noNext: There's no clip right after it on the same track.
toast.nothingToSplit: Nothing under the playhead to split.
toast.pickClip: Select a video or picture clip first.
toast.pickCut: Select the clip before a cut first.
toast.playheadOutside: Move the playhead over the clip first.

exp.title: Export
exp.local: Made on this device — nothing is uploaded and no credits are used.
exp.saveFail: Couldn't save it to your account — download it instead.
exp.noEncoder: This browser can't encode video. Use Chrome, Edge or Safari — or choose “nooi server” above.
exp.tooLong: Longer than {{name}} allows ({{s}} s) — trim it before posting.
exp.serverHint: Made on the nooi server — best for long or 4K videos. Files only on this device are uploaded first (it resumes after a dropped connection). No credits are used.
exp.srvFail: The server couldn't make this video.
exp.srvBusy: Your plan makes one server video at a time — wait for the one running.
exp.srvMissing: {{name}} isn't on this device anymore — add it again.
exp.ffmpegHint: Made on this computer with FFmpeg — every format at full speed, nothing uploaded, no credits.

proj.signIn: Sign in on nooi.ai to see your account's projects.
proj.broughtOver: Your edit from the previous editor is here.
proj.jobMissing: That nooi.ai result couldn't be opened.
proj.classicHint: Some tools of the previous editor (motion graphics, stickers, captions from speech, the AI agents' edits) are still there while they move over:

stk.hint: Tap a sticker to put it over the video at the playhead (3 s). Drag it on the preview, or change its size and time like any clip.

logo.hint: Your logo on the whole video, in a corner.
logo.added: Logo added for the whole video.
logo.tip: Pick a logo clip on the timeline and tap a corner to move it.

sfx.hint: Made on this device — tap ▶ to listen, + to add at the playhead.

gen.hint: Describe it in words — the AI makes it and it lands in your library. The price shows first; credits are taken only when it's made.
gen.placeholder: e.g. a slow drone shot over a desert at sunset
gen.started: Started — it will appear in your library when ready.

tpl.splitHint: Pick clips first (or it uses your newest), then choose a layout: each clip gets its own box.
tpl.instantHint: Your library's videos and pictures, 3 seconds each with soft fades, added to the end of the main track.
tpl.needClips: Add some videos or pictures first.
tpl.more: {{n}} more boxes than clips — add clips to fill them.

file.bad: That file isn't a nooi project.

ws.label: Workspace
ws.audioHint: A taller timeline with sound tools

cloud.title: Saving
cloud.account: Every change is saved to your nooi account and on this device.
cloud.device: Saved on this device. Sign in to keep it in your account and open it anywhere.
cloud.reviewHint: Share a link where others watch and leave notes at exact moments — coming soon.

mate.title: Nooi Mate
mate.hint: Say what you want in plain words — Nooi Mate turns it into steps you approve with one tap.
mate.placeholder: e.g. remove the pauses, make it vertical, add rain
mate.applied: Done — undo is one tap away.
mate.failed: That didn't work — nothing was changed.
mate.none: Not sure what to do with that yet. Try: remove pauses · split here · warm look · add rain · zoom in · speed 2x · make it vertical · title “Hello” · find beach.
mate.local: Runs on this device: no credits are used.
mate.ex3: Add rain and a warm look

rf.title: Crop & reframe
rf.hint: The move runs over the whole clip, slow at both ends. Fine-tune it with the keyframes in Video.

tb.keyframe: Keyframe position, size, turn and opacity here

rs.amber: Some effects — may play less smoothly
rs.red: Heavy — export to see full smoothness

pack.making: Packing the project and its media…
pack.savedMissing: Saved {{name}} with {{n}} files — {{m}} couldn't be read and were left out.
pack.failed: Couldn't make the pack — try again, or save a .nooi file.
pack.opened: Opened “{{name}}” — {{n}} media files are now on this device.

mag.label: Magnetic main track: clips on other tracks stay attached to V1
mag.on: Magnetic main track on — clips on other tracks move with the V1 clip they sit on.
mag.off: Magnetic main track off — every clip stays where you put it.
mag.spine: The main track: delete closes its gaps, and what is attached to it moves with it

mo.animations: Each example plays before you choose it. Entrances start the clip, exits end it, loops repeat through it.

rs2.hint: Make the picked video clip again in another style. You choose the style and the AI model; the price shows first and credits are taken only for what is made.
rs2.pick: Pick a video clip on the timeline first.
rs2.wordsPh: e.g. a woman walks through the market and smiles
rs2.noPrice: The price isn't available right now — try again in a moment.
